QuestInfo.name: [Edelstein] How to Confess Your Crush 1
QuestInfo.0: #b#m310000000##k's #bKindergarten Teacher #p2152001##k wants to confess his love for someone. Go to the front of the school and meet him.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2152001# has a crush on #p2152017#! #p2152001# wants you to find him some flowers that he can use to confess his love. He is convinced that the mysterious #t4032752# would surely win her heart. 

Find #b#t4032752##k and deliver #p2152001#'s confession of love to #b#p2152017##k. #t4032752# can be found somewhere near #b#m310020200##k. Use your normal attack when you discover it.

#i4032752# #t4032752# #b#c4032752# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: When #p2152017# received the #t4032752#, she scoffed and said she didn't know why men give her useless flowers that are inedible.

0.0: L-O-V-E! Such a beautiful thing. I think I'm in love! You know, some of my kindergarten students are already dating. Even THEY know the importance and power of love! To think that I, their teacher, don't have a girlfriend yet! I need to get myself a girl, and quick!
0.1: But my love is even more tragic than the love between Romeo and Juliet in Magatia. You see, I love #p2152017#, a Black Wings Watchman. We should be mortal enemies, but there is one way to overcome our differences!
0.2: There is a flower known as a #b#t4032752##k. It doesn't normally grow in this type of weather, but there is one place in #m310000000# where it grows. If #p2152017# receives the mystical #t4032752# as a gift, she will fall head over heels in love with me, right?

yes.0: Go and get a #t4032752# and deliver it to #b#p2152017##k, along with my undying passion! You should be able to find a #t4032752# in #b#m310020200##k. Pluck it by using a regular attack on it.

no.0: Why must you be so cruel. Are you...jealous?

1.0: Ugh, it's so humid. My nails are splitting. Why doesn't this dinky town have, like, a nail salon or something? And you. You've been standing there staring at me for a while. Did you need something? Oh, hey, is that a Desert #t4032752# you're holding? Are you giving this to me?

yes.0: #p2152001# asked you to deliver this to me? Isn't #p2152001# that young kindergarten teacher? At least he has good taste in women.
yes.1: Unfortunately, I do not care for flowers. They're stupid. Pointless! You can't eat a flower. You can't spend it. Why do sooo many guys insist on giving me flowers?

npc.0: Haven't you gone to #b#p2152017##k yet? Please go find the #b#t4032752##k and deliver it to #p2152017#. I heard that you can get the #t4032752# by taking a hidden portal somewhere at the #b#m310020200##k.

item.0: What is it? I'm busy doing my nails right now. Go talk to someone else.
